eael_tooltip_section_border_color: Tooltip border stroke color; visible when border is enabled.
eael_tooltip_section_border_radius: Corner rounding applied to the tooltip popup element via border-radius.
eael_tooltip_section_box_shadow_box_shad: Shadow effect with horizontal, vertical, blur, and spread distance on the tooltip.
Toggle shadow position: Outline (outside) or Inset (inside) the tooltip box.
Enable or disable the box shadow effect on the tooltip popup.
eael_tooltip_section_color: Text color applied to the tooltip content via color CSS property.
eael_tooltip_section_content: Custom text content displayed inside the tooltip when triggered.
eael_tooltip_section_delay: Delay in seconds before the tooltip disappears on mouse leave.
eael_tooltip_section_distance: Pixel distance between the trigger element and the tooltip popup.
eael_tooltip_section_duration: Animation duration in milliseconds for tooltip show/hide transitions.
eael_tooltip_section_enable: Toggle advanced tooltip functionality on or off for the widget.
eael_tooltip_section_follow_cursor: Tooltip follows cursor: False, Horizontal, Vertical, or Initial position.
eael_tooltip_section_padding: Inner spacing applied to the tooltip content via padding CSS property.
eael_tooltip_section_position: Tooltip placement relative to trigger: top, bottom, left, or right.
eael_tooltip_section_size: Preset tooltip size: small, regular, or large.
eael_tooltip_section_styles: Tab grouping tooltip visual styling controls (colors, shadows, typography).
eael_tooltip_section_trigger: Interaction type that shows the tooltip: click or hover/mouseenter.
eael_tooltip_section_typography_font_fam: Font family for the tooltip text via font-family CSS property.
eael_tooltip_section_typography_font_siz: Font size of the tooltip text via font-size CSS slider.
eael_tooltip_section_typography_font_sty: Font style applied to tooltip text: normal, italic, or oblique.
eael_tooltip_section_typography_font_wei: Font weight (boldness) of tooltip text from 100 (thin) to 900.
eael_tooltip_section_typography_letter_s: Space between tooltip text letters via letter-spacing CSS property.
eael_tooltip_section_typography_line_hei: Vertical space between lines of tooltip text via line-height.
eael_tooltip_section_typography_text_dec: Text decoration on tooltip: none, underline, overline, or line-through.
eael_tooltip_section_typography_text_tra: Text transformation applied to tooltip: uppercase, lowercase, or capitalize.
eael_tooltip_section_typography_typograp: Popover toggle grouping all typography controls for the tooltip.
eael_tooltip_section_typography_word_spa: Space between words in the tooltip text via word-spacing CSS.
eael_tooltip_section_width: Maximum width constraint for the tooltip popup in pixels/units.
eael_tooltip_settings: Tab grouping tooltip settings like trigger, position, delay, distance.
eael_wrapper_link: URL that the entire widget element links to when clicked.
eael_wrapper_link_disable_traditional: Disable browser default link behavior when wrapper link is active.
eael_wrapper_link_section: Section grouping wrapper link configuration controls.
eael_wrapper_link_switch: Enable or disable the wrapper link functionality on the widget.
hide_desktop: Hide widget on desktop breakpoint only via visibility control.
hide_mobile: Hide widget on mobile portrait breakpoint only via visibility toggle.
hide_tablet: Hide widget on tablet portrait breakpoint only via visibility toggle.
motion_fx_blur_direction: Blur effect direction: fade in, fade out, or fade in/out combination.
motion_fx_blur_effect: Popover toggle to enable blurring motion effect during scroll.
motion_fx_blur_level: Intensity of the blur effect from minimum to maximum blur amount.
motion_fx_blur_range: Viewport range where the blur effect is active during scrolling.
motion_fx_devices: Apply motion effects on: desktop, tablet portrait, or mobile portrait.
motion_fx_motion_fx_mouse: Toggle mouse-based motion effects (parallax, tilt) on the widget.
motion_fx_motion_fx_scrolling: Toggle scroll-triggered motion effects (parallax, blur, opacity).
motion_fx_mouseTrack_direction: Mouse track direction: opposite (default) or direct/same direction.
motion_fx_mouseTrack_effect: Popover toggle enabling mouse tracking parallax effect on widget.
motion_fx_mouseTrack_speed: Speed multiplier for mouse tracking parallax effect sensitivity.
motion_fx_opacity_direction: Opacity fade direction: fade in, fade out, or fade in/out combination.
motion_fx_opacity_effect: Popover toggle enabling transparency/opacity motion effect on scroll.
motion_fx_opacity_level: Intensity of opacity change from fully visible to fully transparent.
motion_fx_opacity_range: Viewport range where the opacity effect is active during scrolling.
motion_fx_range: Effects reference point: default, entire page, or viewport-relative.
motion_fx_rotateZ_affectedRange: Viewport range where the rotation effect is active during scrolling.
motion_fx_rotateZ_direction: Rotation direction: to left (default) or to right during scrolling.
motion_fx_rotateZ_effect: Popover toggle enabling Z-axis rotation motion effect on scroll.
motion_fx_rotateZ_speed: Controls rotation speed for the Z-axis parallax/motion effect on the widget.
motion_fx_scale_direction: Determines scale direction (down, down-up, up, up-down) for parallax scale effect.
motion_fx_scale_effect: Toggles the scale motion effect on/off; when enabled, widget scales on scroll.
motion_fx_scale_range: Sets viewport trigger range for scale parallax effect (when to activate/deactivate).
motion_fx_scale_speed: Controls the speed at which the widget scales during the parallax motion effect.
motion_fx_tilt_direction: Sets tilt direction (direct or opposite) for the 3D tilt parallax motion effect.
motion_fx_tilt_effect: Toggles the 3D tilt motion effect on/off; when enabled, widget tilts on interaction.
motion_fx_tilt_speed: Controls the speed of the 3D tilt parallax effect applied to the widget.
motion_fx_transform_origin_x: Sets horizontal transform origin (left/center/right) via --e-transform-origin-x CSS variable.
motion_fx_transform_origin_y: Sets vertical transform origin (top/center/bottom) via --e-transform-origin-y CSS variable.
motion_fx_translateX_affectedRange: Sets viewport trigger range for horizontal scroll parallax effect activation.
motion_fx_translateX_direction: Determines horizontal translation direction (left or right) for parallax scroll effect.
motion_fx_translateX_effect: Toggles horizontal scroll parallax motion; widget moves left/right based on scroll.
motion_fx_translateX_speed: Controls speed of horizontal parallax translation effect during scroll interaction.
motion_fx_translateY_affectedRange: Sets viewport trigger range for vertical scroll parallax effect activation.
motion_fx_translateY_direction: Determines vertical translation direction (up or down) for parallax scroll effect.
motion_fx_translateY_effect: Toggles vertical scroll parallax motion; widget moves up/down based on scroll.
motion_fx_translateY_speed: Controls speed of vertical parallax translation effect during scroll interaction.
section_custom_css: Section header/container for custom CSS settings in editor panel.
section_effects: Section header/container for motion effects settings in editor panel.
sticky: Enables sticky positioning to top or bottom of viewport while page scrolls.
sticky_anchor_link_offset: Sets pixel offset for anchor link scroll destination when using sticky positioning.
sticky_anchor_link_offset_mobile: Sets anchor link offset on mobile breakpoint; overrides desktop setting below 768px.
sticky_anchor_link_offset_tablet: Sets anchor link offset on tablet breakpoint; overrides desktop setting below 1025px.
sticky_effects_offset: Applies vertical spacing offset to parallax/motion effects when widget sticks.
sticky_effects_offset_mobile: Applies motion effects offset on mobile breakpoint; overrides desktop below 768px.
sticky_effects_offset_tablet: Applies motion effects offset on tablet breakpoint; overrides desktop below 1025px.
sticky_offset: Sets distance in pixels from viewport edge when widget sticks to top/bottom.
sticky_offset_mobile: Sets sticky distance on mobile breakpoint; overrides desktop offset below 768px.
sticky_offset_tablet: Sets sticky distance on tablet breakpoint; overrides desktop offset below 1025px.
sticky_on: Specifies which device breakpoints (desktop/tablet/mobile) the sticky positioning applies to.
sticky_parent: When enabled, constrains sticky widget within parent column instead of viewport.
